title: Lattice Function
body_html:
Lattice Function

Let \(V\) be a right \(D\)-vector space. A lattice function on \(V\) assigns to each real number \(s\) an \(o_D\)-lattice \(L_s\), decreasing in \(s\), compatible with scalar translation, and left-continuous: \[ L_t \subseteq L_s \quad(s<t), \qquad L_{s+\nu(d)}=L_s d, \qquad L_s=\bigcap_{t<s} L_t. \] One writes \[ L_{r+}=\bigcup_{t>r}L_t,\qquad \operatorname{Jump}(L)=\{r\in \mathbb R: L_r\ne L_{r+}\}. \]

The lattice function induces filtrations on \(\operatorname{End}_D(V)\) and \(\operatorname{GL}_D(V)\) by requiring operators or group elements to shift every \(L_s\) into \(L_{s+r}\).

In the paper, lattice functions are interchangeable with splittable \(D\)-norms via \(L_r=\ell^{-1}([r,\infty))\).
